scope: Written teaching and independent formative practice; not teacher approval or observed learner execution

closureNotes.Y11-R001: The added B/66 transfer independently converts the character code in three bases and distinguishes a code point from UTF-8 bytes; it closes the former numeric-only task gap.
closureNotes.Y11-R013: The paired arithmetic clinic supplies both representations, all arithmetic operators, declared types and a changed independent calculation rather than relying on the cone example alone.
closureNotes.Y11-R017: The Gantt clinic explains time bars and dependencies and requires a changed schedule with predecessor effects; a fixed allocation table is no longer the sole evidence.
closureNotes.Y11-R023: The structured-benefits clinic compares development, comprehension and modification using a changed calculation, with an explained independent response.
closureNotes.Y11-R025: The structure-chart clinic includes module/data-flow design, a runnable loader stub and replacement; the task requires a fresh chart and file-reader replacement.
closureNotes.Y11-R027: The same chart/stub clinic now supplies an explicit Year 11 independent construction task and expected evidence, not a Year 12-only example.
closureNotes.Y11-R032: The debugger clinic gives breakpoint, before/after inspection and stepping instructions plus a separate independent fault; paper expectations are distinguished from actual observations.
closureNotes.Y11-R034: The fault task explicitly requires execution markers and value probes, first-wrong-state reasoning, removal of probes and regression checks.
closureNotes.Y11-R035: The API clinic distinguishes caller, contract and implementation, models an input/result/error contract and requires an independent call plus inspection of a real documented API.
closureNotes.Y11-R042: The clinic supplies logical-role modelling and an independent changed LAN/WLAN/WAN drawing with addresses, security and a symbol-comparison checklist. The official support-booklet symbol table remains the authoritative visual reference; this is written provision, not a claim of learner symbol fidelity.
closureNotes.Y11-R059: A worked Author/Title schema is followed by a fresh three-table Member/Workshop/Enrolment specification, required keys, data and integrity tests, plus explained expected constraints. Running the worked seed is not counted as independent construction.
closureNotes.Y12-12: The transfer clinic explicitly separates the historical console-loan case from current game FR/NFR evidence and asks for pause/restart, workload/file-size and actual-response observations. No supplied timing is represented as a learner measurement.
closureNotes.Y12-39: The ODBC clinic models the application/interface/driver-manager/DBMS request-result path and contrasts direct sqlite3. A fresh comparison/failure-point task and answer now address the knowledge demand without requiring a driver installation.
closureNotes.Y11-R006: A fresh type-selection and paired-notation task now asks for all four meanings without supplying the type labels in the prompt. It checks a fractional result, leading-zero identifier and both permission states.
closureNotes.Y11-R015: The array transfer now independently requires both pseudocode and Python construction, with explicit load/print and empty/tie contracts.
closureNotes.Y11-R028: The same fresh array task explicitly covers load/print, sum and first min/max positions, with numeric expected results plus empty and one-value feedback.
closureNotes.Y11-R021: The new convention review explicitly addresses all named maintainability practices and a fresh validated-area implementation.
closureNotes.Y11-R038: A changed address/version comparison now explicitly practises mask/locality, gateway responsibility and both address representations.
closureNotes.Y11-R039: The new responsibility-table task names all three media and each prescribed component, and requires a changed labelled diagram with an explicit access-technology assumption.
closureNotes.Y11-R040: A new access task explicitly asks why unauthorised access matters, both firewall flow decisions and OS-level protections.
closureNotes.Y11-R041: A four-case diagnosis now independently practises capacity, design, collisions and excess broadcasts, rather than asking learners to select only two design improvements.
